rule: MVP exists only when all REQUIRED rows are GREEN. Placeholder substitution is never PASS.

required.title: Bounded island document inside WB2
required.delta: Bind bounded island identity to the existing WB2 document/session lifecycle and reuse current recipe/editor/store contracts.
required.proof: Create Island A, unload completely, create same-seed Island B, reload A; document identity and state remain independent.
required.forbidden: Second island runtime/editor or schema-only storage detached from WB2.

required.title: Independent island/session identity + local frame
required.delta: Introduce one island-local origin/frame shared by terrain, Track, objects, colliders, player and queries; replace seed-keyed mutable singleton behavior with document identity.
required.proof: Two same-seed island documents coexist sequentially without shared mutable state; support/contact stays numerically stable after unload/reload.
required.forbidden: Render-group offset while Rapier/Track remain global; seed used as document identity.

required.title: Continuous Surface Truth
required.delta: Finish one authoritative render/support/collision surface with river/village/Track/sculpt contributions reconciled.
required.proof: Same sampled surface drives visible mesh, support and collider; normal-input traversal shows zero ground penetration and coherent road/bridge/water contact.
required.forbidden: Separate visual terrain, support height and collider truth; hanging ribbon water or plate seams.

required.title: Stable WorldObject identity
required.delta: Make authored matrices/state keyed by stable semantic IDs drive regenerated visible geometry and relevant colliders, including updates.
required.proof: Edit a source-pinned object, stream/unload/reload, and recover the same ID, transform, visible placement and collision.
required.forbidden: Render-instance index as durable identity; merged mesh identity loss.

required.title: Deterministic seeded generation + bounded streaming
required.delta: Pin complete generator/source revision + finalized recipe/RouteRecipe; add explicit replacement load/disposal boundary for bounded island sessions.
required.proof: Canonical export is identical at stored precision after full unload/fresh load; same seed with different document IDs stays isolated.
required.forbidden: Reading mutable current recipe files on reload; additive restore that leaks old state.

required.title: Public owner APIs + failure isolation
required.owner: Core integration API / existing specialist owners
required.delta: Expose typed/versioned seams for Surface, Track, WorldObject, persistence and specialist consumers; retain exception isolation.
required.proof: Optional module failure is contained and ordinary PLAY boots; owner calls are observable without duplicate implementations.
required.forbidden: Direct cross-module state mutation or duplicate owner created for convenience.

required.title: Simulation/render budget
required.delta: Measure actual integrated island on target device; apply bounded LOD/instancing/update budgets and Clay distance strategy only where evidence requires.
required.proof: Persist FPS/frame-time, draw calls, visible tris/material counts and no runaway allocations during Ground/Drive/Flight traversal.
required.forbidden: Claiming performance from headless/preview only; optimizing the wrong endless-world architecture.

required.title: LLM-free deterministic default
required.delta: Keep all required boot, movement, Residents' routine/activity and world reactions deterministic without mandatory LLM latency.
required.proof: Cold boot and representative loop pass with AI adapter unavailable/disabled.
required.forbidden: LLM required for movement, save/reload, routine activity, world boot or acceptance.

required.title: Binding Ground controls
required.delta: Reconcile current Ground consumer to binding controls without second listeners/writers.
required.proof: Normal-input capture proves W/S forward/back, A/D turn, Q/E strafe, Shift sprint, Space jump, RMB camera, wheel zoom.
required.forbidden: Parallel movement writer or historical control scheme silently reintroduced.

required.title: P0 locomotion feel
required.delta: Tune consumer speeds/playback from measured clips so default is Jog, Shift is faster Sprint, slow walk is deliberate, Backward is useful and stride-matched.
required.proof: Continuous normal-input video at gameplay camera shows no visible skating/double-step; measured contact/cadence remains synchronized at each speed.
required.forbidden: Speeding the root independently of gait; treating current Motion source readiness as runtime acceptance.

required.title: P0 Cartoon Jump
required.delta: Bind Jump_Start take-off to actual impulse, ballistic air to real trajectory, Jump_Land to actual support contact; add readable cartoon anticipation/compression.
required.proof: Repeated jumps from idle and Jog/Sprint show anticipation→take-off→air→landing with no apex hold, pop, foot slide or early/late landing clip.
required.forbidden: Scripted up/hold/down motion or animation timeline detached from physics.

required.title: Camera
required.delta: Repair camera against current simple island Ground/Drive/Flight routes before reintroducing extreme spiral geometry.
required.proof: Fresh critic normal-input traversal scores >=8.5 and records no head/geometry clipping, wrong-level track view, forced disorientation or lost subject.
required.forbidden: Passing technical occlusion/up-vector probes as product camera acceptance.

required.title: Flight
required.owner: Travel Globe Flight owner consumed by WB2 player/mode bridge
required.delta: Reuse Travel flight physics/camera and accepted double-Space intent; mount same avatar/equipment presentation without second Flight solver.
required.proof: Ground Jump on first Space; second fresh Space within 400 ms requests Flight; take-off, cruise, climb, descend, hover, boost, bank and intentional safe landing all work.
required.forbidden: New flight physics/controller; both Ground and Flight listening/writing simultaneously.

required.title: Mode arbitration
required.delta: Unify explicit ownership tokens/handoffs for Ground, Drive, Flight, Dialogue and Activity using existing mode bridges.
required.proof: Instrumentation shows exactly one authoritative movement and camera owner every frame through Ground→Drive→Ground→Flight→Ground and interaction transitions.
required.forbidden: Implicit listener competition, teleport handoffs or duplicate camera writers.

required.title: Track Core construction + Joyride presentation
required.owner: Track Core construction + Joyride presentation + Surface Truth
required.delta: Route ordinary road and race/fun section through Track Core profiles/sockets/contact, with Joyride visible adapter and Surface reconciliation.
required.proof: Source-isolated Joyride donor and integrated road compare convincingly; road contact/support is Track-Core-derived and visually reads as KFB/Joyride.
required.forbidden: Bespoke Bézier road owner, technical Track slab as final look, custom fallback plate accepted silently.

required.title: Representative road-world seam
required.owner: World route planner → Track Core → Surface Truth
required.delta: Build one simple island loop with POI/village street or sidewalk, bridge/water crossing and modest race/fun segment.
required.proof: Walk/Drive normal-input traversal completes loop and crossing without seam, folding, unsupported bridge end or camera-critical geometry.
required.forbidden: 720° spiral/Race-Tube spectacle used to prove basic island road viability.

required.title: Vehicle / Drive
required.owner: Existing Vehicle/Drive owner with Joyride donor
required.delta: Integrate current Drive on authored route; repair steering/collision/recovery only to the level needed for stable normal traversal.
required.proof: Enter, accelerate, brake, reverse, steer, collide ordinarily, recover and continue driving; no stuck/tunnel/mode-corruption defects.
required.forbidden: Calling historical J17/J14 physics final; rebuilding a second vehicle engine.

required.title: World traversal continuity
required.delta: Preserve avatar/world pose, heading and safe support across Ground↔Drive and Ground↔Flight handoffs.
required.proof: Continuous video performs Ground→Drive→Ground→Flight→Ground without teleport, duplicate input, orphan vehicle/avatar or camera discontinuity.
required.forbidden: Separate mini-game scenes masquerading as seamless modes.

required.title: KFB Clay visual canon
required.owner: KFB Clay presentation owner; family-specific source owners retained
required.delta: Apply K1/H0 Golden + K2/v10 routing per asset family with distance-scaled treatment and correct shadow/contact.
required.proof: Source→Clay-adapted→integrated isolation evidence for terrain, road, building/prop and character sample; critic sees one KFB clay world.
required.forbidden: Default KayKit material, universal one-size shader or clay_floor_001 stand-in promoted as final.

required.title: Claybound Compatibility Gate
required.owner: Visual QA / current KFB Clay + source owners
required.delta: Apply Claybound compatibility review to every new/adapted custom family before integration.
required.proof: Each family passes form/material/palette/contact/silhouette/scale/diegesis checks and does not read as imported from another game.
required.forbidden: Boardgame/paper/fabric/custom asset accepted merely because available or easy to generate.

required.title: Source fidelity / source isolation
required.delta: Require original source-family isolation before visual adaptation and integration; retain source IDs/pins.
required.proof: Evidence shows original source alone, adapted source, close identity proof and integrated view for every material visible family.
required.forbidden: Loaded URL, filename or donor name used as proof the intended design survived.

required.title: Authored composition, not random scatter
required.delta: Compose sparse/medium authored clusters and landmarks using hierarchy/negative space instead of uniform procedural scatter.
required.proof: Gameplay-camera views show clear FG/MG/BG, routes/clearings, distinct zones and living-toy composition; critic >=8.5.
required.forbidden: Bag-of-props scatter, long generic blocks or density used as substitute for composition.

required.title: Grounded placement / no pasted-on props
required.owner: Surface Truth + content placement + visual QA
required.delta: Combine physical snap with local transition treatment: terrain/vegetation/material overlap, root/rock support and authored clusters.
required.proof: Close and gameplay-distance evidence shows zero floating/sunk props and no sticker-like base seams on representative rock/tree/building/landmark.
required.forbidden: y=groundAt alone treated as visual grounding.

required.title: Sky / Environment
required.delta: Consume one existing Environment owner and align island lighting/atmosphere/cloud presentation with KFB/Claybound look.
required.proof: Day/environment state persists and critic sees coherent light, shadow, atmospheric depth and sky; no duplicate environment controller.
required.forbidden: Second sky runtime or generic background color substituted for existing owner.

required.title: Signature Landmark
required.delta: Choose one strong source-proven landmark family and integrate it through Claybound/source-isolation/grounding gates.
required.proof: Landmark reads at distance and close range, grounds physically, survives save/reload and gives island a distinct silhouette.
required.forbidden: Mandatory Life Tree, weak procedural centerpiece or unsupported giant prop.

required.title: Water / river / edge presentation
required.delta: Implement one representative coherent water/river/coast/edge seam owned by Surface Truth and current visual presentation.
required.proof: Ground/Drive/Flight views show coherent water contact, bridge/shore relation and island edge with no dangling band, z-fighting or unsupported waterfall ribbon.
required.forbidden: Decorative ribbon/plane glued to terrain.

required.title: PLAY / BUILD / GOD
required.delta: Expose PLAY/BUILD/GOD in same runtime and preserve mode handoff without second editor.
required.proof: Continuous session enters Build/God, edits world, returns to Play with player/collision/state intact.
required.forbidden: Separate authoring app whose result is not the played world.

required.title: Asset Librarian + direct authoring
required.delta: Require source-isolated asset selection and real PLACE/MOVE/ROTATE/SCALE/SNAP through existing editor.
required.proof: Place one pinned source object, transform/snap it, save/reload and retain source identity + exact transform.
required.forbidden: Generic stand-in object or placement before source isolation is complete.

required.title: Terrain sculpt
required.delta: Serialize native ordered raise/lower strokes with validation and reconcile final evaluation order with Track-fit policy.
required.proof: Overlapping raise/lower strokes replay exactly at stored precision after fresh reload; visible mesh, support and collider agree.
required.forbidden: JSON-only delta claiming Save PASS without geometry/collider replay.

required.title: Layered state
required.delta: Persist Base Recipe, Canon/Authoring Override, Dynamic State and Player Overlay as distinct layers keyed by stable identity.
required.proof: Editing/regeneration does not erase Canon overrides; dynamic/transfer/damage/build states roundtrip without conflating semantics.
required.forbidden: One mutable scene blob where procedural regeneration silently overwrites authored truth.

required.title: Exact Save / fresh reload / import
required.delta: Save complete pinned island document/RouteRecipe/sculpt/object/state; fully unload; fresh import/reload and replay.
required.proof: Canonical export identical at named precision and visual/collider/support/authoring state matches; invalid import preserves last-known-good.
required.forbidden: Same-session reload, registry-only equality or current-source lookup counted as exact persistence.

required.title: Resident
required.delta: Integrate two real source-proven 3D Residents into one POI/activity/reaction loop using current state/POI semantics.
required.proof: Residents persist, navigate/act/react visibly and recover to meaningful activity without requiring LLM.
required.forbidden: Static decorative NPCs or generic substitute models.

required.title: ChatterBox
required.owner: Existing ChatterBox + EyeRig v6 + PetMouth + Resident owners
required.delta: Consume real 3D Residents/Card context and current ChatterBox kernel; close EyeRig/PetMouth/real-Card and presentation fallback gaps.
required.proof: One meaningful dialogue/Triplet/reaction in-world with real resident presentation, valid silence, no PNG/cutout/card-placeholder path.
required.forbidden: Promoting PR357 wholesale as finished runtime or inventing second dialogue engine.

required.title: Card + Almanac
required.delta: Integrate one canonical Card acquire/inspect/provenance record and Almanac representation into island context/persistence.
required.proof: Acquire/inspect real card, verify canonical artwork/provenance, save/reload and re-open Almanac record intact.
required.forbidden: Copied image with no canonical receipt/provenance relation.

required.title: Billboard / HyperNormalisation
required.delta: Wire actual Billboard compositor/scheduler to real read-along/HyperNormalisation content loop in-world.
required.proof: Billboard shows real source-backed media/quote sequence through actual consumer, responds/persists as designed and survives world reload.
required.forbidden: Claude-coded placeholder image/texture or fake billboard panel.

required.title: Real Quote Pool content
required.owner: Quote Curator PR354 data → Billboard consumer
required.delta: Select a bounded mapped/context-compatible subset from the researched pool and feed quote IDs/provenance/rights/FrizzleQuestion/Brain-Food to consumer.
required.proof: Runtime quote rotation resolves source records exactly; no unverified quote promoted; repetition policy avoids immediate author/era/tone collapse.
required.forbidden: Invented filler quotes, stripping provenance/rights, or bulk-mapping all 415 during runtime integration.

required.title: Audio / Jukebox
required.owner: KFB Audio owner / PR365 module + tiny World adapter
required.delta: Inject existing AudioContext/SCORE destination and send only serialized world context/events to Audio module.
required.proof: One environmental/POI transition with runtime-verified family, no second AudioContext/graph, no browser errors and TTS ducking authority retained.
required.forbidden: World-side duplicate stem/BPM tables or independent mixer.

required.title: Signature / Transition compatibility
required.owner: Signature/Landmark adapters + Theatre Curtain accepted donor
required.delta: Integrate signature/transition seam and attach accepted Curtain module compatibly; apply Claybound/KFB visual tune without replacing cloth kernel.
required.proof: Curtain/loading or reveal transition works in actual game route and hands to island runtime cleanly; landmark/transition persists no duplicate UI/world owner.
required.forbidden: Fake plaque/wordmark/SVG overlay or old rejected CPU curtain substituted.

required.title: Early Visual/Physical Golden Gate
required.delta: Run before feature fan-out on actual runtime once Player/Surface/Joyride/Clay/Sky/landmark/water core exists.
required.proof: Fresh critic-owned screenshots/video certify island silhouette, contact, locomotion, road, water/bridge, landmark, Clay/Sky/light and first-frame composition >= required threshold.
required.forbidden: Continuing broad integration on a visibly wrong foundation.

required.title: Negative-Golden regression firewall
required.delta: Encode known failure classes into rubric and compare candidate against negative Goldens.
required.proof: Critic explicitly checks and reports no engineering-slab roads, ribbon water, fake compulsory tree, player penetration, sparse scatter, contamination or pasted props.
required.forbidden: Treating known historical fail pattern as cosmetic/nit.

required.title: No-placeholder firewall
required.delta: Enforce real owner/real content at each integration row.
required.proof: Source manifest shows no placeholder path satisfying a required row; critic verifies visible/runtime consumer is the intended owner/content.
required.forbidden: Any placeholder, generic replacement branding/UI/content, dummy audio/media or substitute source passed as integration.

required.title: Fresh module critics
required.delta: Run read-only critics on required subsystems after integrated implementation, using actual app, normal inputs and critic-owned evidence.
required.proof: Persist critic identity/prompt/head/video/screenshots/raw scores; every required dimension >=8.5 or explicitly repaired.
required.forbidden: Builder self-score, builder screenshots as sole basis, or Georg used as debugger.

required.title: Whole-product critic
required.delta: Drive one continuous product route through movement, Drive, Flight, living/media, authoring, save/unload/fresh reload and return to Play.
required.proof: Critic-owned continuous video + evidence covers full gauntlet on exact candidate head with no required score below threshold and zero unexplained errors.
required.forbidden: Averaging module PASSes into whole-product acceptance.

required.title: Complete-matrix rule
required.owner: Production Guard + Georg final product authority
required.delta: Aggregate only actual accepted proofs from F-R01–F-R43; no row may be inferred green.
required.proof: Machine-readable matrix shows every REQUIRED row GREEN at named proof; only then candidate is routed to Georg as MVP candidate.
required.forbidden: Near-MVP, Receiving-Core MVP, mostly-complete MVP or score averaging over a red row.

stronglyInclude.title: Theatre Curtain Claybound/KFB visual tune
stronglyInclude.owner: Theatre Curtain accepted donor + KFB Clay/Claybound visual owner
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Preserve r3 cloth kernel/momentum/states; adapt only material/stage presentation needed to live in the KFB clay world.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Curtain works in real game entry/reveal without fake overlays and reads Claybound-compatible.
stronglyInclude.quarantine: May defer final cosmetic tune only if required transition compatibility F-R38 is already green.

stronglyInclude.title: Backpack / universal Flight presentation
stronglyInclude.owner: Travel Flight owner + actor equipment/attachment owner
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Backpack grants Flight capability to compatible actors; Flight physics stay in Travel owner; attachment/presentation stays actor/equipment-owned.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: One representative actor equips visible backpack/gear and enters Flight with stable mount/scale/contact.
stronglyInclude.quarantine: Special backpack art polish can defer; universal Flight F-R13 cannot.

stronglyInclude.title: Flight kinetics presentation
stronglyInclude.owner: Travel flight-state presentation consumers + Motion/VFX/Audio owners
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Consume bank/pitch/boost/climb/impact facts for bounded body response, propulsion, speed lines/contrails and SFX.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Flight visibly communicates speed, bank and thrust without changing physics or camera ownership.
stronglyInclude.quarantine: Barrel-roll choreography and advanced secondary motion may defer.

stronglyInclude.title: Resident Life / Reaction / Encounter
stronglyInclude.owner: Resident Life semantic model + current Resident owner
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Use deterministic POI/activity/affect/memory semantics as inputs to current Resident runtime; no second simulation owner.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: At least one resident activity changes/recoveries react to world/player event coherently.

stronglyInclude.title: Resident performance layers
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Reuse source-proven pose/proximity/gesture/micro-motion layers; add no new clips unless current consumer proves gap.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Representative Resident interaction has readable body/face performance and recovery.

stronglyInclude.title: Living-Toy authoring grammar
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Use scenario families/text-scarcity/group-witness rules to shape events; map only to real runtime events after owner audit.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Required interactions avoid everyone-speaks/filler behavior and recover to meaningful state.

stronglyInclude.title: Dialogue authoring rules
stronglyInclude.owner: ChatterBox/Resident authoring QA using Etherington + NIE rules
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Apply causality, SAID/MEANT/WANTED, adjacency pairs, silence/interruption/worldview voice; no NIE runtime dependency.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Representative dialogue passes line-level audit and is character/context-specific.

stronglyInclude.title: Minimal Joyride HUD / Radio/Jukebox controls
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Use only minimal controls that expose real Drive/Audio state; preserve diegetic/low-chrome game view.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Necessary drive/audio controls are usable without obscuring world or duplicating owner state.

stronglyInclude.title: Shared Clay materialize/dematerialize presentation seam
stronglyInclude.owner: UFO/Clay transform presentation adapter + durable state owners
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Share only visual breakup/materialize/assemble grammar; Transfer, Damage and Construction/Rebuild remain separate semantic states.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: At least one low-risk object transition uses shared clay presentation and restores/retains canonical source object correctly.
stronglyInclude.quarantine: Can defer if it threatens required world/persistence gates.

stronglyInclude.title: Bounded seeded procedural structure provider
stronglyInclude.owner: Seed World generator donor behind WB2 world model
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Use deterministic street/parcel/BuildingRecipe grammar only as provider; Surface Truth height, Track Core roads, Claybound/source gates remain authoritative.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: If used, generated structure has stable ID, street relation, source/visual role and passes Grounding/Claybound/performance gates.
stronglyInclude.quarantine: Entire provider may defer if authored POI cluster already satisfies required composition.

stronglyInclude.owner: Style Reference / Etherington curated consumer packs
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Select only 3–6 exact references for concrete island problems; source-isolate before deriving KFB rules.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: Any applied cloud/environment/grounding rule cites inspected reference IDs and improves actual runtime composition.

stronglyInclude.owner: Fluff Work Motion PR356 + Resident activity consumer
stronglyInclude.integrationRule: Use existing 17 Medium/13 Large clips only if selected activity needs them; EyeRig owner stays authoritative.
stronglyInclude.acceptance: One chosen Fluff/work activity consumes real clip(s) with contact/readability in world.
stronglyInclude.quarantine: If no MVP activity needs Fluff, defer without creating new clips.
